name: yipyap-language
description: Practice a language during ordinary work with verified YipYap teaching context.

interface.longDescription: Practice a language while working on everyday questions in ChatGPT. YipYap follows your chosen language and teaching level when your connected YipYap account provides fresh teaching context. Eligible new words and their meanings can be proposed to My Lexicon for review in the YipYap app; displaying a word does not prove it was saved or mastered. Account connection, Learning Mode, teaching level, and pronunciation permission are separate controls managed in YipYap. If fresh teaching context is unavailable, YipYap continues the underlying task without adding language practice.

publication.release_notes: Updated the shared YipYap teaching Skill to use fresh account context and respect task-local pause and unavailable-context states. Teaching answers follow the verified language dose and keep the compact current-reply footer last. Short or mostly structured replies stay plain. The static help reference is updated. The existing hosted MCP connection and account permissions are unchanged.
